# mcp-einvoicing-core

> Base package for European electronic invoicing MCP servers

## Docs

- [Overview](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-einvoicing-core/): what this server does and how to install it
- [Installation](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-einvoicing-core/installation/): install via uvx
- [Configuration](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-einvoicing-core/configuration/): required environment variables
- [Tools](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-einvoicing-core/tools/): full MCP tool reference
- [Standards](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-einvoicing-core/standards/): standards and profiles implemented
- [Changelog](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-einvoicing-core/changelog/): version history
